title: NewPipe: free YouTube Premium alternative
caption:
YouTube Premium charges $15.99/month to remove ads and play in the background. NewPipe does both for free 📺

✅ Plays YouTube without ads, no Google account needed
✅ Listen in the background with the screen off, audio only to save data
✅ Floating popup player so you can watch while using other apps
✅ Download videos or just the audio, and subscribe to channels without signing in

💻 Android
ℹ️ Android only, still in beta, and not on Google Play: install it from F-Droid or the APK on GitHub

Comment "TUBE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
